blocks.text: Since the time of Abraham, God has made many promises to His people. He has kept every one of them from Abraham to Isaac to Jacob, as well as Joseph. A time of much trouble similar to the one that is arising in our time. Then God sent Moses to deliver his people. (Ps. 105:37) He has always been there with the right servant to deliver a timely and vital message. Truly Brother Neal Frisby’s scroll message has been right on time. There never has been such an hour where all of God’s promises will mean so much. He will do exceedingly and abundantly for you. (Read Eph. 3:20) – Again this month I have some past notes that Brother Frisby left with me. It truly sizes up the hour we are living in. At the end of this letter I will be telling you about a new Special Writing. And now Brother Neal Frisby.

“Never in the history of the world have we seen such startling and marvelous prophetic events! Greater geological upheavals are coming. Tremendous changes are coming in society. The apostasy and immoral conditions are beyond comprehension. A flood of different events have occurred in the nations, crises, tragedies, and so forth. This is just the edge for many more will be occurring soon!” – “So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors!” (Mark 13:29) Mark 13:34-37, verse 34 reveals, “Jesus was like a man taking a journey and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, then they were commanded to watch!” – “Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning! Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping! And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch!” – Matt. 24:44 says, “Be ready, He will come in such an hour as ye think not!” We are entering this vital and watchful hour now! Time shortening!

I Peter 4:7, “But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer!” – It’s the age that we must be alert, for we are living in dangerous and perilous times. “We are seeing the final prophecies fulfilling, and as it says all things is at hand. And the real people of God will surely be tried and tested, and persecution will arise! But they most certainly will be victorious!” Paul faced far more severe conditions than exist for us today! He was beaten, rejected, shipwrecked, forsaken by friends and faced death on every hand, etc. – “And yet he had a secret, he would not accept defeat! And he revealed this in his words in order to help us!” His formula was, he said always rejoicing. (II Cor. 6:10) – Giving thanks always! (Eph. 5:20) – Praying always, and always abounding in the work of the Lord! (I Cor. 15:58) “And he said, Always confidant!” ( II Cor. 5:6) – Paul said he always tried to remain content in the Lord no matter what the circumstances. He knew Jesus would find a way to help him in every test! “For He said, all things work together for good to them that love God!” (Rom. 8:28) So we see, no matter what, the Lord will always be ready to bless and guide you!

“Jesus is directing each day, each month and each year who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will!” (Eph. 1:11) – Isa. 44:7, “And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? And the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them!” – “All that He has declared concerning Israel shall come to pass, and all He has declared concerning the Gentile elect will take place! – Those who are writing are being guided by divine providence! Declaring to us the beginning ‘til the age ending. His cloud and pillar of fire will comfort us!”

Isa. 44:8, “Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? Ye are even my witnesses, is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any!” (Read Isa. 9:6) – “The Scriptures say the Word of the Lord shall not return void, He will bring in the remaining harvest! Events are breaking forth all over the world. Signs show us that time is short! As you wait on the Lord in good courage He will strengthen your heart! He will not fail thee nor forsake thee, but will keep and bless you!” – In St. John 14:2-3 Jesus reveals the mansions are prepared, and says I will come again and receive you unto Myself! “This will absolutely take place!” And as the age closes He promises strength instead of weakness for us as we unite together in love, prayer, unity and faith! – Eph. 6:10, “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of His might!” End quote.

This month I have a new powerful and timely Special Writing called “Prophecy Marches On.” Almost all of this special writing has come to pass which brings us ever closer to the end of time. Judgement will surely fall upon all nations. It will bring about the anti-Christ and the false prophet as well as a controlling mark or number. This is a vital and special message! I also am releasing a DVD called “The Youth” which will fit right in with this special writing. – There will be a special blessing on all who help publish this vital and wonderful message. May the Lord’s greatest blessings be with you.
All three new CD’s/Cassettes, $15.00 donation: New DVD release: “The Youth” “Always Present” Also available: “Profound Promises” “Abiding Faith” ($20.00 donation each) “Fear Limits”
